beschreibung:
Chris Welsh, Pat Fitzmaurice, and Andrew Erickson break down the Week 2 fantasy football quarterback and tight end rankings, including some major disagreements near the top of the board.
Should fantasy managers trust Joe Burrow in a difficult matchup, or start Jaxson Dart, Baker Mayfield, or another upside option instead? The crew also digs into Geno Smith and Carson Wentz as deeper streaming plays.
At tight end, they debate Dallas Goedert, George Kittle, Mark Andrews, Kyle Pitts, Harold Fannin Jr. and more while sorting through fantasy football’s most unpredictable position.
